steps.en: LTA sends the daily renewal-notice report
steps.id: LTA mengirim daily report renewal notice
steps.why_en: No interface for a renewal-notice report exists; only the vehicle ownership enquiry files are built.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada interface untuk report renewal notice; yang ada hanya file enquiry kepemilikan kendaraan.

steps.en: OCMS fetches files from LTA's file server twice a day
steps.id: OCMS mengambil file dari server file LTA dua kali sehari
steps.why_en: The fetch job only reads the vehicle ownership result file, not a renewal-notice report.
steps.why_id: Job hanya membaca file hasil kepemilikan kendaraan, bukan report renewal notice.

steps.en: OCMS reads the report and picks out the right vehicles/owners
steps.id: OCMS membaca report dan mengenali kendaraan/pemilik yang tepat
steps.why_en: No code reads or stores renewal-notice data or links it to warrants.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang membaca atau menyimpan data renewal notice atau mengaitkannya ke warrant.

steps.en: Officer opens the LTA report list and filters by date
steps.id: Officer membuka daftar report LTA dan memfilter tanggal
steps.why_en: The LTA report list exists but only lists the ownership check report, not renewal notices.
steps.why_id: Daftar report LTA ada, tetapi hanya berisi report cek kepemilikan, bukan renewal notice.

steps.why_en: Download works, but there is no renewal-notice report to download.
steps.why_id: Download berfungsi, tetapi tidak ada report renewal notice yang bisa di-download.
